common.style_usage: Stardew Valley building pixel art: palette, outline weight, how the roofs are shaded in rows of tiles or shingles with light ridges, dark gable edges and deep shadow under the eaves, and the high top-down front camera where the roof fills over half the building
common.reference_usage: camera, silhouette and roof planes: the lighter roof colour is roof facing up toward the viewer, the darker is roof facing forward, the darkest band is the shadow under the eaves; keep this outline, these openings, and the roof taking more than half the height

fern_cottage_r1.description: A gardener's small cottage in Stardew Valley pixel art: a golden straw thatched roof with a few wildflowers growing in it, cream walls, a round-topped green door, flower boxes under the windows; attached on the right, a small glass seedhouse that is a little version of the farm's greenhouse in the second reference: copper-orange frames, glass panes, a steep glass gable, green seedlings visible inside, and a FULL-SIZE door with an arched fanlight: the seedhouse door is exactly as tall and as wide as the cottage's green door, both doors the size of a person. Seen from above and in front like the Stardew Valley town buildings, a steep front-gabled roof whose ridge runs back away from the viewer, two big thatched roof planes (lit on the left, shaded on the right) filling about 60% of the height. Building only, nothing around it, no ground, no text, transparent background. The whole building fits inside the picture with a little space above the roof's ridge: draw the complete roof, nothing cut off.
reference_images: camera, silhouette and roof planes: the lighter roof colour is roof facing up toward the viewer, the darker is roof facing forward, the darkest band is the shadow under the eaves; keep this outline, these openings, and the roof taking more than half the height
the game's own greenhouse: copy its design, frames, glass and colours for the small seedhouse on the cottage's right; draw it much smaller, as in the first reference
